name: @jumentix/cana-react
description: React hooks and Redux-friendly helpers for @jumentix/cana.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @jumentix/cana build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false && bun run build:esm
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --target browser --external react --external @jumentix/cana && bun build src/redux.ts --outfile dist/redux.mjs --format esm --target browser --external @jumentix/cana
scripts.lint: echo "cana-react: covered by the root eslint run"
